title: Seville tour
text: Antonio was amazing; very friendly and knowledgeable. The tapas were great. We got to see all the major sites at a leisurely pace.
author: ramoneW4444QV

title: The tour goes beyond history and culture
text:
We arrived early at the meeting point and Antonio was already there. The tour was very organized, and he had the necessary tickets ready and timed each entry perfectly.
But here is where Antonio knocked it out of the park. In addition to explaining the history and culture, he explained the origins of many things we take for granted based on what we saw. He also explains different perspectives of historical events. Everything is clear and easy to understand. A very interesting and entertaining tour. Highly recommended.
author: Richard_M

title: Great tour
text:
Antonio was a wealth of knowledge and very friendly. We enjoyed every minute of this tour and recommend it highly to people of all ages. 
Melanie and Ernesto
author: Melanie_B

title: Anthonie was extremely...
text: Anthonie was extremely knowledgeable about all the parts of the tour. He even taught us where some of the common expressions we use in the States came from! He planned lunch break at the exact time there was a downpour so we weren’t walking in the rain. I highly recommend this tour for anyone. There is a lot of walking so be prepared.
author: Shelley_V

title: Would recommend!
text: Antonio was amazing! He took us all around Seville, brought us to an amazing lunch spot, and got us front row seats to a flamenco show. He was friendly, informative, and a great guide.
author: Y7134QLlindseym

title: Fascinating Full-Day Tour
text:
From 10A to 4P (with a break for lunch) it was indeed an outstanding day!  We walked around/through and looped back from the river to city centre. 

Antonio, our guide radiated his pride of his city and it was contagious enthusiasm.  
He provided more information than we could absolutely absorb - but it was fascinating how it linked up with all our previous locations visited in Spain and of course, back to America. 

I would highly recommend this tour.  We were six adults and it was perfect headcount to hear and ask questions.
author: Kymmi-On_The_Go

title: Best way to experience Sevilla
text: This was a very good tour. Our guide Juan was fantastic. Took us to all the sites as well as other areas of interest. His knowledge of the city as well as historical data was spot on. Even the lunch break restaurant he recommended was very good.
author: Miguel_R

title: Excellent tour in Seville
text: I highly recommend this tour!  Raquel was an excellent guide that gave us great information and made the tour a lot of fun!  My teenager enjoyed it as much as my husband and I did.  The tour includes all the top sights in Seville and makes a perfect experience for a port stop or the first day of a longer stay.
author: Margo_S

title: Great experience!
text: Juan, our tour guide, was so amazing!  His knowledge from growing up in Seville and education was exceptional!! He made the day amazing. We loved every minute in Seville!
author: MikeLawrence

title: Amazing experience
text: Antonio was amazing!!! He had si much knowledge and explained in a way that kept everyone interested! He showed us the best of seville! We loved every minute of the tour and we highly recommend him!
author: JULIANA_G
